title: Monoidal adjunction for derived pullback across independent universes
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and f:X→Y [def-pc-scheme], and specify derived categories of their module sheaves in independent universes [def-pc-derived-category]. For the exact transported functor L=derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses f [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes] and R=schemeDerivedDirectImage f [def-pc-derived-direct-image], using the fixed K-flat derived tensor structures [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], there exists a CoreMonoidal structure m on L and an adjunction L⊣R. CoreMonoidal means coherent invertible tensor and unit comparison maps. No finiteness condition on f or perfect tensor argument is required.

source.place: Tags 079U (derived tensor comparison), 079W (unbounded derived adjunction), 06YJ (K-flat pullback); derived.tex, Tag 05RU (localization)

proof.text: Take core monoidal structures on the functors of the two standard localization equivalences, obtain the monoidal structure on the inverse of the X equivalence, and compose these with the standard derived pullback monoidal model. The composed functor is definitionally derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses.

Apply derivedModulePullback_adjunction to the underlying ringed-space morphism, obtaining a left-derived L and its adjunction to the specified direct image. The new left-derived comparison for derivedPullbackAcrossUniverses has the same underived P. leftDerivedUnique gives an isomorphism from L to the specified transported pullback; transport the adjunction along it. Pair its Nonempty witness with the composed core monoidal structure.
